## Problem and decision

What user-visible problem does this solve? Why this approach?

## Verification actually performed

Commands, observed results, screenshots for UI changes, and platforms exercised. List prerequisites or untested boundaries; do not mark unrun checks as passed.

## Data, permissions and compatibility

Does this affect unsaved edits, file identity, review versions, sessions, credentials, command execution or persistence? Explain conflict/recovery behavior.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests exercise plausible behavior/edge cases rather than source text or incidental wording.
- [ ] UI changes were exercised in actual Electron, including relevant narrow/light/dark states.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated where relevant.
- [ ] No user documents, credentials, profiles, runtime databases, generated binaries or private logs included.
- [ ] Third-party code has provenance, license and corresponding-source/build requirements addressed.
